root_cause.text: Calling mt76_set_channel() while already holding dev->mutex causes a deadlock because mt76_set_channel() also acquires dev->mutex.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "mt76_remain_on_channel() and mt76_roc_complete() call mt76_set_channel() while already holding dev->mutex. Since mt76_set_channel() also acquires dev->mutex, this results in a deadlock." The patch replaces mt76_set_channel() with __mt76_set_channel() (which does not acquire the mutex) and adds cancel_delayed_work_sync() to prevent a secondary deadlock with the mac_work workqueue.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix locking issue by calling the internal __mt76_set_channel() which does not attempt to re-acquire locks already held in the roc_complete path.
intent_record.what: Replace mt76_set_channel() with __mt76_set_channel() in mt76_roc_complete() when setting main channel after remain-on-channel completion.
intent_record.how: The change alters the channel update call to use the internal version that assumes the caller already holds the necessary locks, avoiding potential deadlocks or unnecessary lock acquisitions.

intent_record.intent_summary: Cancel pending mac_work to prevent race condition during remain-on-channel setup.
intent_record.what: Added a call to cancel_delayed_work_sync(&phy->mac_work) before acquiring the mutex lock.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any pending delayed work (mac_work) is cancelled and completed before proceeding with the remain-on-channel setup, preventing race conditions.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add error handling for channel set failure in mt76_remain_on_channel, cleaning up allocated resources on error.
intent_record.what: Replaced mt76_set_channel call with __mt76_set_channel, added error handling that cleans up roc state (roc_phy, roc_vif, roc_link) and releases vif phy link on failure, then jumps to out label.
intent_record.how: On failure of __mt76_set_channel, the function now correctly tears down partially allocated resources (setting pointers to NULL and releasing the link) before returning with an error code, preventing inconsistent state and potential crashes.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the deadlock by using __mt76_set_channel(), which avoids re-acquiring the mutex already held in the roc_complete path.

The group's changes focus on canceling mac_work to prevent a race condition, not on resolving the double mutex lock deadlock caused by calling mt76_set_channel() while holding dev->mutex. These are distinct concurrency issues.

The group adds error handling for channel set failure, but does not address the double locking of dev->mutex that causes the deadlock. The change does not directly modify mutex acquisition or release, nor does it prevent the call to mt76_set_channel() while holding the mutex.
